description: Desktop furniture: the work-area insets a taskbar, Dock, menu bar or panel contributes, plus the browser's own outer-minus-inner window deltas. The axis stores insets, not absolute coordinates, because availLeft and availTop are panel-relative and a multi-monitor capture reports a large availLeft with a zero inset. avail_left = left + inset_left, avail_width = width - inset_left - inset_right, and likewise vertically.
label: furniture

options.note: Measured on the Apple M4 Max reference host: availTop 33 is the macOS 26 menu bar, and 86 CSS pixels of the bottom edge are reserved by the Dock (1117 - 33 - 86 = 998). outerHeight - innerHeight = 87 is the browser's own chrome.
AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED: an auto-hiding Dock reserves no work area, so only the menu bar inset remains.
AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED: the left-edge Dock width is authored.

options.note: AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED: the macOS 15 menu bar is 24 CSS pixels rather than the 33 measured on macOS 26. Only the macOS 26 value is a capture.

Measured on the Windows reference host: 48 CSS pixels of the bottom edge are reserved by the taskbar (1080 - 48 = 1032). availLeft was 1920 because the capture ran on a second monitor at x=1920; the inset itself is 0, which is why this axis stores insets rather than absolute coordinates. outerHeight - innerHeight = 121.

The Windows 10 taskbar reserves 40 CSS pixels of the bottom edge at every scale factor: in the public corpus screen.height - availHeight is 40 with no horizontal inset on 5307 of 7122 Windows 10 sessions. A Windows persona always shows the bottom taskbar gap; top, side and auto-hide taskbars are a small minority and are left out. The browser chrome delta is carried over from the Windows 11 measurement.
options.source: public Windows Chrome 115-119 session corpus (windows_fingerprints.json, 10,000 sessions, not in the repository): bottom inset 40 on 5307 of 7122 Windows 10 sessions

options.note: Measured on the Linux NVIDIA Ada reference host: availTop 32 is the GNOME top bar and nothing else is reserved (852 - 32 = 820). outerHeight - innerHeight = 143, which the stock Linux host reproduces independently.
Measured on the stock Linux reference host: no reserved work area at all, and the same 143 chrome delta.
